1. Hi Jo, our teacher says that the blog is ready to read. Please check the title before we share the link with the class. Sam

2. CLASS STORY — Ruby tells us that her grandfather will visit on Friday. Write one question you would like to ask him.

3. Hi Dad, I think my history file is on your tablet. Please send it to me when you have time. Eva

4. BLOG UPDATE — We found the wrong year in our story, so we have corrected it. Please use the new document.

5. Hi Sam, I hope you will enjoy the course. I have added a vocabulary list at the end. Jo

6. STORY CLUB — You may describe a memory in writing or record your voice. Choose the way that helps you explain it clearly.
